neighbours.label: the first digit of a later share in a breakdown of a whole: the second or third percentage after an earlier one ("80% nitrogen, 20% oxygen")
fire: Brass is roughly 70% copper, 30% zinc, depending on the grade.
The shirt is 65% polyester, 35% cotton and machine washable.
Dry air is about 78% nitrogen, 21% oxygen, and the rest is argon.
Of the budget, 80% goes to salaries, 20% goes to equipment.
The voters split 52 percent for the measure, 48 percent against.
The blend is 75% merino wool, 25% nylon for strength.
The crop was rated 45 percent good, 35 percent fair and the rest poor.
The population is about 85% urban, 15% rural according to the census.
quiet: Brass is roughly 70% copper, depending on the grade.
The shirt costs 65 dollars, has 35 buttons and is machine washable.
Dry air is mostly nitrogen, and the rest is oxygen and argon.
Of the budget, 80% goes to salaries.
The voters came from 52 towns, and 48 buses were hired.
The blend is merino wool with nylon for strength, made in 1975.
The crop was planted on 45 farms over 35 days and looked poor.
The population is about 85 thousand, according to the census of 2015.

notes: Card: peaks on the first digit of the complementary percentage in lists of shares. Probes: '90% copper, 10% tin' 0.59, '60 percent cotton, 40 percent polyester' 0.57, three-way split 0.32; a single percentage 0.00–0.01, a list of plain counts 0.05, a 4-3-3 formation 0.01.
